title: Sega Flash Vol. 5
overview:
Volume 5 of Sega's European Sega Flash demo disc series, offering a sampler of Saturn games.

Playable demos:
- Sonic Jam
- Die Hard Arcade
- Sonic 3D: Flickies' Island
- Sega Rally Championship

Video demos:
- Last Bronx
- Resident Evil
- Dragon Force
- Wipeout 2097
- Duke Nukem 3D
- Sega Touring Car Championship
- Enemy Zero
